sections.name: goal
sections.value: Ship Pij Emergent Communities (PEC): a per-project directory of roles that outlive their seats, grown from what the work needs and reshaped as it changes, with memory, outputs, routing and prompts for the prime.

value.title: Docs system and the community PRD
value.done_when: Schemas resolve; this PRD, its blueprint and this roadmap validate clean; `ddocs graph` draws the joins.

value.title: Role schema, layout and the governance writer
value.done_when: `pij directory add` writes a validated role on the governance branch, refuses by name without governance or ddocs, and the cost row is measured.

value.title: Core and security templates
value.done_when: A new directory prompts for the five core roles and security and creates nothing (C22); a role made from a template records it; a template bump shows a diff.

value.title: Assign, release, lineage and the directory view
value.done_when: Lineage survives a store rebuild; the view lists roles and holders for this project only.

value.title: Send to a role, the role queue and reply modes
value.done_when: The 0, 1 and 2 holder cases, instances, the PA wake and the three reply modes behave as the PRD says.

value.title: Outputs and notification
value.done_when: Parallel outputs never conflict; the requester is notified in its chosen mode.

value.title: Role memory and its prompts
value.done_when: Notes are one file each with a generated INDEX.md, and a role holder's compact and close are each preceded by the memory turn.

value.title: Routing table
value.done_when: ROUTES.md regenerates on a scope change and reaches seats at the four triggers.

value.title: Prime prompts
value.done_when: Each prompt condition shows with its runnable command.

value.title: Number claims and delivery at merge
value.done_when: Parallel claims never collide, and a merged PR's delivery shows on the requirement and the PM's card.

value.title: Time limits and check-ins
value.done_when: The three req-22 cases behave as written, with no new timer or launch.

value.title: Doc procedures and examples in the skill
value.done_when: A fresh PM writes a valid, linked PRD and roadmap from the procedure.

value.title: Triage pij's earlier register into PRD 002
value.done_when: PRD 002 validates under docs/project/prds/ and every open row of the earlier register has a recorded verdict.

value.title: Community skill route and optional templates
value.done_when: A fresh prime follows the route and stands up a working community.

value.title: Reshape: retire and merge roles
value.done_when: A retired or merged role keeps its memory, outputs and lineage readable; a send to it refuses by name, naming the target after a merge.

value.title: Workstreams: rename, nesting, lanes and coverage
value.done_when: Roadmap 001 lives in docs/project/workstreams/ as pij/workstream, every reader follows the folder, and harness checks fails naming the row when a requirement is delivered by no step, a component is built by no step, or an umbrella step is complete before its children.

value.title: Seat ids never name a role or project
value.done_when: A spawn whose `--id` names a role in its project's directory or a project is refused by name; a spawn without `--id` still gets a `pij-<adjective>-<animal>` id.
value.note: The open part of req-26 (ruling C13). Memorable ids and `<project>:<role>` windows shipped (s04, plan 195); an explicit `--id` is still accepted as given (crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:1426-1438).

value.change: Added s11 (claims, delivery at merge); widened s05 and s07.
Plan 191: s01 complete (done-when checked, docs/plans/191-doc-procedures/assets/evidence/s01-check.md); s13 complete; needs filled for s02, s13 and s14 (req-24).
s14 is a triage into a fresh PRD 002, not a move.
Plan 192: s14 complete. The earlier register was triaged into PRD 002 (docs/project/prds/002-pij-base.dd.json); 16 of 40 open rows kept as 14.
Plan 190: s02 complete (`pij directory add` and `--batch` on the governance writer; evidence in docs/plans/190-community-writer/assets/evidence/phase-2.md).
Plan 195: s04 complete (assign, release, close-ends, lineage, the view and rebuild; evidence in docs/plans/195-assign-lineage/assets/evidence/phase-2.md).
Renamed forward per ruling C26: title and goal name Pij Emergent Communities (PEC). Slugs and step ids unchanged.
s03 complete (plan 194); its done_when now says the core roles are prompted, not created (ruling C22).
Plan 196: s11 complete (number claims and delivery at merge; evidence in docs/plans/196-claims-delivery/assets/evidence/).
Plan 202: s08 complete (the routing table: ROUTES.md rewritten with every role write, overlap warnings, held FYIs on assign, compact and revive, changed rows to the prime, `pij directory routes`).

s09 complete (plan 203): pij directory is the prime's operating picture (holders with seat liveness, waiting requests, latest output, memory freshness, the designated prime), next actions with runnable commands, and prompts for roles a roadmap step needs.
s15 added (reshape: retire and merge roles, req-28, C26), plan 206, in progress.
s15 depends on s05 (its send refusal needs role sends) and needs docs-system, reviewer and security (it changes the pij/role schema, C7).
Plan 206: s15 complete (pij directory edit, retire and merge; retire waits for queued role requests; a retired or merged role refuses sends).

Plan 204: s10 complete (the /pij community route, ten optional templates, templates --show; a fresh-prime canary stood up a community from the route). s10 also delivers req-27 and req-29, the route half of C26 and C28.
Plan 210 phase 2 (ruling C29): moved from docs/project/roadmaps/ to docs/project/workstreams/ and switched to the pij/workstream schema in the same commit.
Plan 210 phase 2: s16 added and complete (the move to workstreams, nesting and lanes, and the coverage sensor in harness checks).
Plan 210 AC4: s17 (planned) delivers req-26's open part, refusing an explicit seat id that names a role or project, so no PRD 001 row is left undelivered.
